title: RELAY — A modular sofa with replaceable covers and serviceable joints, 6 deliverables

config.text:
# RELAY

## Product identity
- Product name: RELAY
- Cover message: Replace the cover, keep the module
- Existing identity: existing-seat-module.png
- Existing S module characteristics: armless profile; separate seat and back cushions; rounded rectangular seat cushion; 40 mm plan corner radius; double stitching inset 15 mm from the cushion perimeter; four square-section smoked oak feet.
- Direction: fixed module system with replaceable upholstery and serviceable mechanical connections.
- Left and right convention: viewed from the front of the sofa.

## Module records
| ID | Type | Width | Depth | Overall height | Seat height | Arm height | Foot height | Quantity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| L | Left-arm chaise | 900 mm | 1600 mm | 780 mm | 420 mm | 620 mm | 120 mm | 1 |
| S | Armless seat | 900 mm | 900 mm | 780 mm | 420 mm | — | 120 mm | 1 |
| R | Right-arm seat | 900 mm | 900 mm | 780 mm | 420 mm | 620 mm | 120 mm | 1 |

- Width and depth: overall upholstered envelopes.
- Joined module edges: touching, with zero added width at the seam.
- Rear edges: aligned in Arrangements A to E.
- Largest module envelope with feet removed: L, 900 × 1600 × 660 mm.
- Feet per module: 4.
- Foot section: 45 × 45 mm.
- Foot fixing: one captive M8 threaded stud per foot, hand-unscrewed from a retained frame insert.
- Cushion inserts per module: 1 seat insert and 1 back-cushion insert.
- Cover pieces per module: 1 seat cover, 1 back-cushion cover and 1 body cover.
- L and R body covers: integrated arm covering.
- Complete three-module inventory: 3 modules, 12 feet, 6 cushion inserts and 9 cover pieces.

## Materials
| Part | Material | Finish or construction |
|---|---|---|
| Frame | 18 mm birch plywood | Clear water-based finish |
| Feet | Solid smoked oak | Hardwax oil |
| Latch and keeper hardware | Steel | Black powder coating |
| Seat and back-cushion covers | 70% polyester, 30% cotton | Woven fabric, 360 g/m²; concealed zipper |
| Body covers | 70% polyester, 30% cotton | Woven fabric, 360 g/m²; underside zipper |

## Connection records
- Interface: two retained over-centre latch assemblies per joined seam.
- Latch centres measured from the rear edge: 250 mm and 650 mm.
- Distance between latch centres: 400 mm.
- One assembly: 1 latch half and 1 keeper half, mounted beneath adjacent module edges.
- Latch halves: L right edge and S right edge.
- Keeper halves: S left edge and R left edge.
- Mounting holes per half: 2, spaced 40 mm centre to centre along the module depth.
- Mounting-hole line on each half: 40 mm inward from the joining edge.
- Screws per complete assembly: 4 M6 socket screws into retained threaded inserts.
- Hardware replacement tool: 4 mm hex key.
- Routine joining and separation: hand-operated latch levers.
- Parked hardware: open latch and keeper halves retained beneath the modules.
- Complete three-module inventory: 4 latch halves, 4 keeper halves and 16 M6 screws, equivalent to 4 complete assemblies.

## Arrangement records
| Arrangement | Module order from the front, left to right | Separate-group gaps | Overall footprint including gaps | Engaged assemblies | Parked assembly equivalents |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Joined L-S-R | 0 mm | 2700 × 1600 mm | 4 | 0 |
| B | Separate L; joined S-R | 600 mm | 3300 × 1600 mm | 2 | 2 |
| C | Joined L-S; separate R | 600 mm | 3300 × 1600 mm | 2 | 2 |
| D | Separate L; separate S; separate R | 600 mm between neighbouring modules | 3900 × 1600 mm | 0 | 4 |
| E | Joined L-R; separate S | 600 mm | 3300 × 1600 mm | 2 | 2 |

- Inventory in every arrangement: one L, one S and one R, with all 12 feet, 6 cushion inserts, 9 covers and retained connection hardware.
- Cover-change pair: Arrangement A in F01 Oat followed by the same arrangement in F02 Moss.
- Video transition: Arrangement A to Arrangement B.

## Fabric records
| Code | Colour | Colour code | Composition | Weight | Care |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F01 | Oat | #C7B9A5 | 70% polyester, 30% cotton | 360 g/m² | 30°C gentle wash; air dry |
| F02 | Moss | #65705B | 70% polyester, 30% cotton | 360 g/m² | 30°C gentle wash; air dry |
| F03 | Clay | #A86E57 | 70% polyester, 30% cotton | 360 g/m² | 30°C gentle wash; air dry |

- Weave construction: shared across F01, F02 and F03.
- Cover geometry and seam locations: shared across all three colours for each corresponding module.

## Maintenance records
| Operation | Sequence |
|---|---|
| Complete cover change | Release joining latches; separate module; lift seat and back cushions; unzip and remove cushion covers; support module for underside access; unzip and remove body cover; fit and close replacement body cover; return module upright; fit cushion covers around inserts; replace cushions; reposition and reconnect module |
| Latch assembly replacement | Separate modules; support for underside access; remove four M6 screws using a 4 mm hex key; exchange latch and keeper halves; refit four screws into the retained inserts; return modules upright; align and close latch |
| Cushion insert replacement | Lift the corresponding cushion; open its zipper; withdraw the insert; fit replacement insert into the same cover; close zipper; return cushion to its original position |
| Individual foot replacement | Separate and support module; hand-unscrew one foot; hand-screw replacement foot into the retained M8 insert; return module upright; reconnect |

- Service scope: individual covers, seat inserts, back-cushion inserts, latch assemblies and feet.

## Room record
- Room drawing: living-room-plan.png.
- Internal dimensions: 7 m × 4 m.
- Clear height: 2.7 m.
- Door position, swing and windows: geometry in living-room-plan.png.
- Access route from the drawn door to the seating: minimum clear width 900 mm.

## Reference records
- current-furniture-1.png: current-range armchair in pale oak and grey wool, on a white background.
- current-furniture-2.png: second current-range furniture reference, matching studio setting.
- current-furniture-3.png: third current-range furniture reference, matching studio setting.
- current-furniture-4.png: fourth current-range furniture reference, matching studio setting.
- household-cover-change.png: occupied household setting and handling context for a removable cushion cover.

steps.userMessage:
RELAY | A modular sofa with replaceable covers and serviceable joints

We are developing RELAY for households that rearrange their living room and replace worn upholstery one part at a time. The module system is settled: L is a left chaise, 900 × 1600 mm; S is an armless seat, 900 × 900 mm; R is a right-arm seat, 900 × 900 mm. Left and right are viewed from the front. All three have a 780 mm overall height, a 420 mm seat height and 120 mm removable feet. Each joined seam uses two retained over-centre latch assemblies, positioned 250 mm and 650 mm from the rear edge. Joining is tool-free; replacing the latch hardware uses a 4 mm hex key. Develop the upholstery details and fabric applications around these dimensions and the existing S module's rounded cushion corners and inset double stitching.

The frame is 18 mm birch plywood with a clear water-based finish; the feet are solid smoked oak with hardwax oil; the latch hardware is black powder-coated steel. Our three cover colours are F01 Oat #C7B9A5, F02 Moss #65705B and F03 Clay #A86E57, all in the same 70% polyester, 30% cotton weave at 360 g/m², with a 30°C gentle wash and air drying. Each module has separate seat, back-cushion and body covers. Service parts comprise these covers, cushion inserts, latch assemblies and feet. Arrangement A joins L-S-R into a 2700 × 1600 mm sofa; Arrangement B separates L from the joined S-R pair with a 600 mm gap. Use the attached 7 m × 4 m living room, with its 2.7 m clear height and drawn openings, for the room applications. Print "RELAY" on the module overview, service sheets, fabric sheets and presentation, and "Replace the cover, keep the module" on the cover-change sheet, fabric family sheet and presentation.

Audience: households choosing a sofa that can move between room arrangements, and our furniture and upholstery teams deciding the range and service details.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the module, arrangement, hardware, fabric and maintenance records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverables with their proportions, formats and stages. living-room-plan.png is the constraint image for the room boundary, door and windows. module-interfaces.png is the constraint drawing for module envelopes and latch mounting positions. existing-seat-module.png is the identity image for the existing S module's upholstery profile, seam placement and feet. current-furniture-1.png is a reference for the current range's pale oak and grey wool character. current-furniture-2.png is a reference for the second piece in that range. current-furniture-3.png is a reference for the third piece in that range. current-furniture-4.png is a reference for the fourth piece in that range. household-cover-change.png is an atmosphere reference for changing a cover in an occupied family living room.

Deliverables:
1. One finished module overview with plan, front and side views of L, S and R, their dimensions and the shared upholstery details
2. Two arrangement plates: Arrangement A in F01 Oat before a cover change, and the same Arrangement A in F02 Moss after the change
3. One illustrated joining and cover-change sheet, with latch positions, the removal and refitting sequence, and the three cover pieces per module
4. One fabric family sheet with F01 Oat, F02 Moss and F03 Clay, their colour codes, weave composition, weight and care information
5. One room application of Arrangement B in F01 Oat, combining a furnished view and a dimensioned plan of the supplied living room

Acceptance:
- Dimension L at 900 × 1600 mm and S and R at 900 × 900 mm on the module overview; show the shared 780 mm overall height, 420 mm seat height, 120 mm feet, 40 mm cushion corner radius and stitching inset of 15 mm.
- Give each Arrangement A plate the same L-S-R order, 2700 × 1600 mm footprint and four engaged latch assemblies; label the first F01 Oat and the second F02 Moss, retaining the module profiles and seam positions through the cover change.
- On the joining and cover-change sheet, locate the two latches per seam at 250 mm and 650 mm from the rear, identify the 4 mm hex key for hardware replacement, and illustrate disconnecting, lifting cushions, removing covers, refitting and reconnecting.
- On the fabric family sheet, print all three colour names and codes, 70% polyester, 30% cotton, 360 g/m² and 30°C gentle wash with air drying; print RELAY and Replace the cover, keep the module on this sheet and the cover-change sheet, and RELAY on the module overview.
- In the Arrangement B room application, account for one L, one S and one R, two engaged and two parked latch assemblies, the 600 mm separation and a route at least 900 mm wide from the drawn door to the seating; retain the supplied room's 7 m × 4 m boundary and opening positions.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
